experiment_description: An ultra-compact weak-focusing electron storage-ring demonstration beamline was operated to test three-dimensional spiral injection with and without a pulsed vertical kicker. A thermionic electron gun and chopper generated an electron bunch with momentum p = 297 keV/c, kinetic energy 80 keV, and pulse width 100 ns. The beam was transported through three rotatable quadrupole magnets, one bending magnet, and a pair of steering magnets, then injected into a solenoidal storage magnet at a pitch angle of 0.7 rad relative to the horizontal X-Y plane. The storage magnet consisted of main and auxiliary solenoidal coils adjusted with opposite polarities to provide a solenoidal field Bz = 8.77 mT on the storage midplane Z = 0 cm and a weak-focusing field with field index of order 10^-2 in the storage region. The storage-ring diameter was 22 cm and the electron revolution period was 4.7 ns. For the kicker-on condition, a 45 A, 140 ns pulsed current was applied to kicker coils of inductance 1.3 microhenry located at Z = ±15 cm, producing a radial magnetic field component Br < 0 along the injected trajectory to maintain downward steering into the weak-focusing region. For the kicker-off condition, the same beamline and magnet settings were used but no kicker pulse was applied. Beam storage was measured destructively with a vertically inserted plastic scintillating-fiber probe consisting of a 1 mm diameter, 20 cm long scintillating fiber read out by a photomultiplier tube. In the reported example, the probe tip was inserted to the storage midplane so that the fiber covered Z = 0 cm to Z = 20 cm. Waveforms from the scintillating-fiber probe, a bottom-mounted plastic scintillator beam-loss monitor, and the kicker current were averaged over 1000 shots. The noise level sigma_noise was defined as the rms voltage fluctuation in a pre-injection time window, and the operational storage criterion was a scintillating-fiber signal exceeding 5 sigma_noise for at least 1 microsecond after injection.

beam_storage_observed_with_kicker.description: Whether the scintillating-fiber probe signal satisfied the operational storage criterion when the 45 A, 140 ns kicker pulse was applied.

beam_storage_observed_without_kicker.description: Whether the scintillating-fiber probe signal satisfied the operational storage criterion when no kicker pulse was applied.

minimum_observed_storage_signal_duration.description: Lower bound on the duration for which the scintillating-fiber probe signal remained above the 5 sigma_noise threshold in the kicker-on measurement.

experiment_description: The vertical distribution of the stored electron beam was measured under four weak-focusing magnetic-field configurations in the same three-dimensional spiral-injection storage-ring apparatus. The injected electron beam had momentum p = 297 keV/c, kinetic energy 80 keV, pulse width 100 ns, and a 0.7 rad injection pitch angle relative to the horizontal plane. The storage magnet maintained Bz = 8.77 mT on the Z = 0 cm storage midplane while the main-coil and auxiliary-coil currents were set to four opposite-polarity configurations: (IMAIN, IAUX) = (8.70 A, 5.20 A), (8.82 A, 5.67 A), (9.20 A, 7.16 A), and (9.60 A, 8.72 A). The 45 A, 140 ns kicker pulse was applied to the kicker coils at Z = ±15 cm for beam storage. A 1 mm diameter, 20 cm long plastic scintillating-fiber probe read out by a photomultiplier tube was inserted vertically from above into the storage region. For each magnetic-field configuration, the probe insertion depth Z, measured from the storage midplane, was scanned in 5 mm steps. At each Z position, the waveform was averaged over 1000 injected shots. The integrated probe signal ISignal was computed by integrating the measured voltage waveform from t = 560 ns to t = 9000 ns after injection, starting just after the end of the kicker pulse. For each coil-current configuration, the upper edge of the stored-beam distribution was defined as the Z position at which ISignal decreased to 5% of its maximum value for that configuration. Edge-point values were read from the plotted Z-scan analysis.

stored_beam_upper_edge_point_cm_imain_8_.description: Approximate upper edge of the stored-beam vertical distribution for main-coil current 8.70 A and auxiliary-coil current 5.20 A, defined by the 5%-of-maximum integrated scintillating-fiber signal criterion.

Approximate upper edge of the stored-beam vertical distribution for main-coil current 8.82 A and auxiliary-coil current 5.67 A, defined by the 5%-of-maximum integrated scintillating-fiber signal criterion.
